explication: This is a Vapor HTTP wrapper for Apple’s on-device Foundation Models, exposing an OpenAI-compatible API. A client posts a prompt or conversation; routing decodes the request, constructs a model session, selects ordinary or streaming response generation, and returns completion data or SSE chunks. The documented surface also includes model listing and structured JSON-schema outputs. Setup and inference wiring are shown in the excerpts; the streaming and structured-output branches are implemented in the sampled session and response-generator modules. No database-backed product behavior is evident despite database configuration.
